notes.title: Exciting Updates and a Journey Through Troubleshooting! 🎮
notes.notes:
I'm thrilled to share some great news and a bit of a behind-the-scenes story from our development adventures. First off, we've made a sweet addition to our menu – a shiny new Discord link! 🎉 This is your express pass to join our vibrant community, where you can share your thoughts, feedback, and maybe a few laughs with fellow enthusiasts and yours truly. I can't wait to hear your impressions and engage in lively discussions with each one of you. 🗨️💬

Now, let's talk about a rather epic battle I had – not in the game, but in the realm of development. 🎮⚔️ My quest to integrate Sony controllers directly into our game has been quite the saga. After much effort, I must report that this particular fight ended in an unexpected way. To integrate these controllers seamlessly, one needs to become a PlayStation partner. As much as I'm passionate about this, it's a mountain that's a bit steep for me to climb at the moment. 🏔️🎮

But fear not! I recommend using DS4Windows as a nifty workaround. It's a fantastic tool that will help you connect your Sony controllers to the game with ease. It's not the solution I hoped to offer, but it's a reliable bridge until we can cross that partnership threshold in the future.

Remember, every challenge in development is a step towards growth, and every feedback from you is a step towards excellence. So, keep those impressions coming, and let's continue making this journey extraordinary together!

notes.title: Hotfix Implemented for Enhanced Controller Sensitivity
notes.notes:
Crucial hotfix in our latest game update. This update introduces a new feature for controller users: the ability to adjust the minimum sensitivity threshold of the controller sticks.

This enhancement was developed in response to feedback from our player community who experienced issues with unintended camera drift and character movement. With the new "Controller Threshold Stick" setting, players can now fine-tune the sensitivity of their controllers, ensuring a more precise and tailored gaming experience.

We appreciate your continued support and feedback, which are vital in helping us improve the game. Happy gaming!
